label: nothing
what: No coordinated secret preparation is established by what I have observed. A surprise marking my forty years of service is conceivable, but unsupported: reports of work at the inn were explained as routine storeroom checks, no repairs were requested, and the secretary reported empty hall tables. Tea and ordinary office activity do not establish knowing participation. I estimate a 0.30 probability that some undisclosed joint preparation is under way; its purpose and participants remain unknown.
